caption: The drawing depicts an ornate curtain or drapery set against a rectangular background. The upper portion consists of a horizontal golden rod with a central, circular decorative element featuring a sun-like motif, and smaller similar motifs at both ends. Draped from the rod is a translucent blue fabric with repeated vertical red and white patterned bands, bordered along its lower edge by a trim with white lace-like details. Behind this sheer layer, a heavier dark green curtain with vertical folds is visible. The bottom of the curtain is adorned with a wide, intricate border in gold and red, displaying geometric and floral patterns. Ornate yellow scrollwork decorates the lower and side edges of the curtain, with touches of blue-gray and white at the corners. The background is a neutral, light tan color, and the artist's name “HOLGER HANSEN” is printed at the bottom right corner.
title: Wall Paper Border Design
